people.name: Pilate

translations.web: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.
translations.bsb: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
translations.kjv: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
translations.asv: this man went to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded it to be given up.
